text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain has launched a campaign to reduce unemployment; think-tanks being set up to find employment solutions.
- Bahraini expert expects Gulf to emerge as a re-insurance centre.
- Up to 184.7 million shares worth 39.9 million dinars changed hands on Bahrain stock exchange in 1995.
- Bahrain's bourse slips back after recent gains. Index fell 14.71 on Wednesday.
